关闭时由 Android 逐项询问应用权限。开启后会自动授予应用请求的普通运行时: Off: Android asks for each permission. On: automatically grant requested runtime permissions; special permissions still require manual approval. Enable only for trusted APKs. Turning it off does not revoke existing grants.

已注册 .apk 关联时，在资源管理器里双击 APK 也会直接装到 ApkSta: When .apk file association is enabled, double-clicking an APK in File Explorer installs it in ApkStart.
首次使用：打开右上角设置 → 运行时 → 一键完成，再回来安装应用即可。: First launch: open Settings → Android runtime → One-click setup, then return here to install apps.
提示：所有应用共享同一个 Android 运行时，所以第二个应用的启动几乎是瞬时: Tip: apps share one Android runtime, so opening additional apps is usually fast.

可在应用卡片右键创建桌面快捷方式。: Right-click the app card to create a desktop shortcut.
应用正在独立窗口中运行（顶部可旋转屏幕）。: App running in a separate window (use the top bar to rotate).
运行时未部署 —— 打开设置 → 运行时，一键完成: Android runtime not configured — open Settings → Runtime → One-click setup
运行时引擎未安装 —— 打开设置 → 运行时一键完成: Runtime engine missing — open Settings and run One-click setup
运行时已就绪 —— 安装 APK 或双击桌面图标会自动开机: Android runtime is ready — installing an APK or using a desktop shortcut will start it
清空安卓 /data 用户数据 + 已装应用 + 快速启动快照，还原成刚装好系统: Delete Android /data, installed apps and quick-boot snapshots; restore a fresh system state
扫描并清掉旧版本留下的程序目录、失效的卸载项和更新临时文件: Remove old program folders, broken uninstall entries and update cache
安卓虚拟机没有网络时（应用里联网页面一直黑屏/转圈），用这个把安卓数据重置掉来修: Network repair may reset Android data if the emulator cannot connect. The app list is retained and apps reinstall when opened.
